nodes.Name: sysctlnametomib
nodes.DocComment:
sysctlnametomib fill mib with dynamically assigned sysctl entries of name,
return count of effected mib slots, return 0 on error.

nodes.Name: newosproc
nodes.DocComment:
May run with m.p==nil, so write barriers are not allowed.

go:nowritebarrier

nodes.Name: newosproc0
nodes.DocComment:
Version of newosproc that doesn't require a valid G.

go:nosplit

nodes.Name: libpreinit
nodes.DocComment:
Called to do synchronous initialization of Go code built with
-buildmode=c-archive or -buildmode=c-shared.
None of the Go runtime is initialized.

go:nosplit
go:nowritebarrierrec

nodes.Name: mpreinit
nodes.DocComment:
Called to initialize a new m (including the bootstrap m).
Called on the parent thread (main thread in case of bootstrap), can allocate memory.

nodes.Name: minit
nodes.DocComment:
Called to initialize a new m (including the bootstrap m).
Called on the new thread, cannot allocate memory.

nodes.Name: unminit
nodes.DocComment:
Called from dropm to undo the effect of an minit.

go:nosplit

nodes.Name: mdestroy
nodes.DocComment:
Called from exitm, but not from drop, to undo the effect of thread-owned
resources in minit, semacreate, or elsewhere. Do not take locks after calling this.

nodes.Name: setSignalstackSP
nodes.DocComment:
setSignalstackSP sets the ss_sp field of a stackt.

nodes.Name: sysSigaction
nodes.DocComment:
sysSigaction calls the sigaction system call.

nodes.Name: fixSigactionForCgo
nodes.DocComment:
fixSigactionForCgo is needed for Linux.

nodes.Name: asmSigaction
nodes.DocComment:
asmSigaction is implemented in assembly.

nodes.Name: raise
nodes.DocComment:
raise sends a signal to the calling thread.

It must be nosplit because it is used by the signal handler before
it definitely has a Go stack.

nodes.Name: sigPerThreadSyscall
nodes.DocComment:
sigPerThreadSyscall is only used on linux, so we assign a bogus signal
number.
